welcome.title: Connect your first tool, {name}.
welcome.intro: AnythingMCP turns any API into MCP tools your AI agent can call. Start with a few ready-made connectors, pick more from the marketplace, or bring your own API.
welcome.searchLabel: What should your AI client work with?
welcome.noMatch: Nothing in the catalog matches. You can still <link>add your own API</link>.

marketplace.title: Browse the marketplace
marketplace.body: 265 pre-built connectors. OAuth, API keys, refresh-token rotation, all wired up. Pick one and follow the setup.

custom.title: Add your own API
custom.body: Paste an OpenAPI URL or JSON spec and we generate MCP tools for every endpoint. Works for REST, SOAP, GraphQL.

graph.title: More than a proxy — it learns how your tools connect
graph.body: As you use your connectors, AnythingMCP builds a knowledge graph of how your entities relate and turns recurring patterns into skills — so your agent chains the right tools in the right order instead of guessing. It gets smarter the more you use it.

welcome.comeBack: You can always come back and add more connectors from the dashboard.
